name: dashboard-deepseek-v4-pro-layers
description: deepseek-v4-pro's 243 KV layers as vLLM v0.32.0 builds them at fp8_ds_mla (d000): sliding-window MLA at block 64, compressed MLA and indexer caches at block 256 with tokens_per_state 4 and 128, and the compressor states at blocks 8 and 4, which get_kv_cache_groups packs into five groups of several block sizes on the indexer backend's block-outermost layout.
